svg.title: ConstructSync Core Entity Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Ten core tables with business fields, unlabeled Crow's Foot relationships and distinct header colors.

g.title: A named user with one of the seven roles; Administrator is a role, not a separate entity.
A construction project with its allocated budget, site location and Drive archive folder.
Supplier contact and business details used by quotations and POs.
A project material request created by Site Personnel and reviewed by the Project Manager.
One requested material, quantity, unit, required date and delivery location.
A dated supplier offer for an MRF with its currency, review status and source reference.
An order sourced from a quotation, with the actual supplier, reviewed amounts, payment mode and Finance scheduling fields.
Accounting's verification of an external supplier payment using archived proof.
One scheduled supplier-to-site, supplier-to-warehouse or warehouse-to-site batch with its receipt milestone.
A material-specific project stock receipt, usage or adjustment; balances are derived from movements.
